Rahul Gandhi said the INDIA bloc's protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar was one united protest, not multiple demonstrations, asserting that the entire Opposition was standing together. The LoP further alleged that people travelling from Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Haryana, Telangana and Punjab were being stopped from reaching the protest venue. Watch
